title: Scan
body:
Syntax: scan <direction>  (n, s, e, w, ne, nw, se, sw, u, d also work)

Description: General Skill learned at level 3. See the visible players, mobs, corpses, and ground items in one adjacent room. Perception 40+ reveals room names and visible characters/mobs a second room away; Perception 65+ reaches a third room along the same open route. Invisible targets do not appear. Closed doors and hidden exits block scanning. Practice with a teacher before first use. Each completed scan, including an empty room, can improve proficiency using the normal jutsu usage rules: a (100 - current proficiency)% chance to gain up to 2 percentage points, capped at 100%. Each percentage point gained awards 10 character XP. Failed or blocked scans grant no growth. Scanning through a controlled elemental clone trains the real character.

Date: 2026-10-23
